name: What are common challenges during interior framing and how are they addressed?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges during interior framing and how are they addressed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during interior framing include dealing with uneven subfloors, unexpected structural issues discovered during demolition, or changes to the design plan mid-project. Our approach involves thorough pre-construction assessments to identify potential issues early. For instance, if an uneven subfloor is found, it will be leveled before framing begins to ensure plumb and square walls. Clear communication and proactive problem-solving with the client are key to addressing such challenges efficiently and keeping the project on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges like uneven subfloors or unexpected structural issues are addressed through thorough pre-construction assessments and proactive problem-solving to maintain project schedule and quality.
